allow: PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 4; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/status" -TimeoutSec 8 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\)"; $r.Content } catch { Write-Host "Error: $_" })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/status" -TimeoutSec 10 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\)"; $r.Content } catch { Write-Host "Still not up: $_" })

PowerShell(Set-Location "C:\\crypto-dashboard"; Start-Process python -ArgumentList "server.py" -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/status" -TimeoutSec 8 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\)"; $r.Content } catch { Write-Host "Not up yet: $_" })

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/unlocks" -TimeoutSec 8 -UseBasicParsing; $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "items: $\($_.items.Count\)  generated: $\($_.generated\)  source: $\($_.source\)" })

PowerShell(Write-Host "=== /api/unlocks ===" ; $u = \(Invoke-WebRequest "http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/unlocks" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 8\).Content | ConvertFrom-Json ; Write-Host "items: $\($u.items.Count\)  generated: $\($u.generated\)" ; $u.items | Select-Object token,date,pct,cat | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Write-Host "=== /api/debug_llama \(chain fields sample\) ===" ; $d = \(Invoke-WebRequest "http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/debug_llama" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20\).Content | ConvertFrom-Json ; Write-Host "Total chains: $\($d.chain_names_sample.Count\)"; Write-Host "--- Watchlist debug ---"; $d.watchlist_debug | Format-Table name,found,tvl,change_7d -AutoSize)

PowerShell($d = \(Invoke-WebRequest "http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/debug_llama" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20\).Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "=== DEX tests ==="; $d.dex_test | ConvertTo-Json; Write-Host "=== Chains with 'hyper' ==="; $d.chain_names_sample | Where-Object { $_ -match "hyper|Hyper|world|World|plasma|Plasma" } | Sort-Object)

PowerShell($d = \(Invoke-WebRequest "http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/debug_llama" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20\).Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "All 80 chain names:"; $d.chain_names_sample | Sort-Object | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ })

PowerShell($chains = \(Invoke-WebRequest "https://api.llama.fi/v2/chains" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 15\).Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $chains | Where-Object { $_.name -match "Hyper|hyper|HL" } | Select-Object name,tvl | Format-Table)

PowerShell(Write-Host "Fetching /api/onchain \(may take 15-20s for first call\)..."; $r = Invoke-WebRequest "http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/onchain" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 45; $d = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "=== Top 5 Chains ==="; $d.top_chains | Select-Object -First 5 | Format-Table name,tvl,change_1d,change_7d,change_1m -AutoSize; Write-Host "=== Watchlist \(chain changes\) ==="; $d.watchlist | Format-Table name,actual_name,tvl,change_7d -AutoSize; Write-Host "=== Stables \(first 8\) ==="; $d.stables | Select-Object symbol,mcap,change_7d | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Write-Host "Waiting for /api/onchain \(uses cache now, should be faster\)..."; $r = Invoke-WebRequest "http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/onchain" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 45; $d = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "=== Watchlist ==="; $d.watchlist | Format-Table name,actual_name,tvl,change_7d -AutoSize; Write-Host "=== Stables ==="; $d.stables | Format-Table symbol,mcap,change_7d -AutoSize; Write-Host "=== Unlocks ==="; \(Invoke-WebRequest "http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/unlocks" -UseBasicParsing\).Content | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object -ExpandProperty items | Select-Object token,date,pct | Select-Object -First 5 | Format-Table)
